retirement_age.notes: statutory is the highest of the two values. Normal retirement age for people first insured after 30 April 2008 is 60 for men and 58 for women; it is scheduled to rise gradually from 2036 to 65 for both (end year 2044 to 2048 depending on source). Since March 2023, people first insured on or before 8 September 1999 can retire at any age once contribution conditions are met.

open_questions: Election date: the normal date is reported as 2028-05-07 (Wikipedia says no later than 2028-05-14). A presidential adviser has proposed 2028-04-16 if parliament votes to renew elections (360 of 600 votes needed); no vote has been held. Presidential and parliamentary elections are held together.

term_ends is null: the exact end date of Erdoğan's current term (elected May 2023) was not found in a source. Erdoğan was prime minister 2003 to 2014, president since 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2023.
